newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Avalanches kill five people in Swiss Alps.
newsitem.headline: Avalanches kill five people in Swiss Alps.

text.p: A series of avalanches killed five skiers in the Swiss Alps at the weekend, the Swiss news agency ATS said.
Four of the deaths were in the Valais region and one in Davos.

In Nendaz, rescue dogs found the body of a 47-year-old man buried under snow on Sunday. In nearby Greppon Blanc region, two skiers were hit by an avalanche and one died in hospital. Other victims included one skier in Siviez-Nendaz and one in La Videmanette near Chateau d'Oex.
ATS also said that in the French Alps and Pyrenees, five skiers were killed by avalanches at the weekend. It gave no other details.
